name: fresh beat 10 s old is alive
spec: True exactly when beat can be read as a number and now - beat <= stale (a beat in the future is fresh).

name: beat exactly stale (60 s old) is alive
spec: True exactly when beat can be read as a number and now - beat <= stale (a beat in the future is fresh).

name: beat 61 s old is not alive
spec: True exactly when beat can be read as a number and now - beat <= stale (a beat in the future is fresh).

name: beat in the future is fresh
spec: True exactly when beat can be read as a number and now - beat <= stale (a beat in the future is fresh).

name: numeric string beat is readable
spec: state is a dict (or null) that may hold "beat" (epoch seconds, a number or a numeric string).

name: non-numeric string beat is not readable
spec: Missing, null or non-numeric beat → false.

name: null state is not alive
spec: Missing, null or non-numeric beat → false.

name: missing beat key is not alive
spec: Missing, null or non-numeric beat → false.

name: custom stale=30 accepts a 30 s old beat
spec: True exactly when beat can be read as a number and now - beat <= stale (a beat in the future is fresh).

name: notify when there is no notified_at
spec: otherwise true when state has no readable numeric "notified_at", or now - notified_at > grace; else false.

name: no notify when notified 599 s ago
spec: otherwise true when state has no readable numeric "notified_at", or now - notified_at > grace; else false.

name: notify when notified 601 s ago
spec: otherwise true when state has no readable numeric "notified_at", or now - notified_at > grace; else false.

name: no notify when notified exactly grace (600 s) ago
spec: otherwise true when state has no readable numeric "notified_at", or now - notified_at > grace; else false.

name: alive desk never notifies even with old notified_at
spec: false when desk_alive(state, now, stale); otherwise true when state has no readable numeric "notified_at", or now - notified_at > grace; else false.

name: custom grace=100 notifies when notified 200 s ago
spec: otherwise true when state has no readable numeric "notified_at", or now - notified_at > grace; else false.

name: null state notifies
spec: false when desk_alive(state, now, stale); otherwise true when state has no readable numeric "notified_at", or now - notified_at > grace; else false.
